tasks.answer: TravelerBookingDetailScreen — export name: TravelerBookingDetailScreen; import path: @/features/traveler-bookings/booking-detail-screen; required props: bookId. Caveat: the catalog contains no dedicated special-passenger (特殊旅客) booking-detail component; this is the general traveler booking-detail screen and is the closest same-domain match serving that role. It requires query and router providers, and its actions are permission-gated.

UiPopup — export name: UiPopup; import path: @/components/ui/overlay. Required prop: onClose. Optional: open defaults to false, position defaults to bottom (bottom/side popup with mask, safe-area and scroll handling).

Login page — SignInPage, import @/features/auth/sign-in-page (staff sign-in page with password and SMS tabs, captcha and redirect handling; no required props). Top nav bar — UiNavBar, import @/components/ui/navigation (top navigation bar with back/left/right actions; no required props, back uses router history unless onBack/onClickLeft is supplied). Both components are present.

FlightDelayCompensationListScreen — export name: FlightDelayCompensationListScreen; import path: @/features/flight-delay-compensation/list-screen; required props: context, onContextChange. It lists delay events and settlement batches with filters and tabs; queries are enabled only with the query permission.
UiImageViewer — export name: UiImageViewer; import path: @/components/ui/image-viewer; required props: image, open, onClose. Fullscreen image viewer; renders null while closed.
